title: Ectype role manifest (contract version 2)
description: The JSON document a role mod embeds in its assembly under a resource name ending in "ectype-role.json". Property names are matched case-insensitively by the framework; this schema uses the canonical spelling. Unknown properties are ignored by the framework and allowed here. String values for "type", "target", "kind", "displayType" and the tag criteria are matched case-insensitively and trimmed by the framework; the enums here list the canonical lower-case or documented spelling.

contractVersion.description: Must equal the contract version the installed framework implements. Any other value rejects the role.

minFrameworkVersion.description: Oldest framework version the role works with, "major.minor.patch". A framework older than this rejects the role. Absent means no minimum.

roleId.description: Namespaced stable id, conventionally the plugin GUID. Seeds every derived GUID and the ordinal sort key across installed role mods. Never rename after shipping.

roleName.description: Display name. Shown upper-cased as the tree title.

roleDesc.description: Role tooltip body. Rich text allowed.

roleIcon.description: Icon key (embedded PNG resource name without extension) for the role icon the crew HUD, lobby and gene tree draw for the role.

roleIconDonor.description: PerkBuffContainer GUID whose icon the role borrows when roleIcon names nothing loadable. 32 hex characters, dashes allowed.

color.description: Accent colour as an HTML hex string. Omitted or unparseable renders the tree white with a warning; R+G+B of 700 or more (of 765) is warned as too close to white.

hero.description: The row-0 banner perk. Its key defaults to "hero"; row, col and wide are forced to 0, 0 and true. Its name is not validated. An unrecognised target rejects the role.

perks.description: Perks in rows 1 to 7. Partial grids are legal.

customStats.description: Stats declared by this role. Inert until code reads them.

suppress.description: Vanilla perk-tree GUIDs (32 hex, dashes allowed) whose trees do not exist while this role is installed.

suppressRoles.description: roleIds of other framework roles whose trees do not exist while this role is installed.

classId.description: Contract version 1 name, renamed roleId in version 2.

className.description: Contract version 1 name, renamed roleName in version 2.

classDesc.description: Contract version 1 name, renamed roleDesc in version 2.

suppressClasses.description: Contract version 1 name, renamed suppressRoles in version 2.

guid.description: 32 hex characters; dashes are removed and case is ignored.

target.description: Where a perk's effects land. character: the player, always on (default). seat: the manned module, applied on sit and removed on stand. seatShip: the ship's stat collection while seated in any chair. characterShip: the ship's stat collection for every holder, seated or not (added in framework 0.18.1). An unrecognised value skips the perk, or rejects the role when it is on the hero.

guidList.description: Item GUIDs, 32 hex each, dashes allowed.

levelCount.description: Level (pip) count. The effective count is the largest of 1, this value and the number of entries in mods.

levels.description: One entry per level; each entry is the complete effect list at that level, not an increment.

key.description: Stable id within the role, unique case-insensitively across hero and perks. The perk GUID derives from (roleId, key) unless guid pins one.

guid.description: Explicit perk GUID overriding the derivation.

icon.description: Icon key: an embedded PNG whose resource name ends with <key>.png.

iconDonor.description: PerkBuffContainer GUID whose icon this perk borrows when icon names nothing loadable.

row.description: 1 to 7. Row 0 is the hero. The grid is 8 rows shaped [1,3,1,3,3,1,3,1]; a row past 7 fails when the terminal builds. The framework itself rejects only a row below 1.

col.description: 0 to 2 on the three-cell rows (1, 3, 4, 6). Single-cell rows (2, 5, 7) force the column to 0.

wide.description: Whether the perk fills a wide cell. A perk in a wide cell must declare true; a perk anywhere else must omit it or declare false, and true there is rejected. Absent means false. The wide cells are rows 2, 5 and 7.

emptyOk.description: Declares that an empty level is intentional, which silences the per-launch empty-level warning for this perk.

effect.description: One stat modifier at one level. A missing or unresolvable stat or type skips the effect with a logged error and the level registers without it.

stat.description: A StatType name, a custom stat declared in this manifest, or a raw integer id.

type.description: percent: +X% (AdditiveMultiplier). scalar: xN (ExponentialMultiplier). flat: PrimaryAddend. flat2: SecondaryAddend. Or an exact ModifierType name.

value.description: percent 0.25 is +25%. scalar 0.25 is x1.25. flat is the addend. Negative values reduce. Truncated to an integer when kind is int.

kind.description: float (default) builds a FloatModifier, int builds an IntModifier. Any other value falls back to float with a warning.

tagList.description: Tag names resolved against the game's tag table, for example "Tag_DamageType_Kinetic". The "Tag_" prefix is optional.

criteria.description: and: every listed tag must be present (default). or: any one. Any other value falls back to and with a warning.

name.description: Stat name referenced from effect lines. The id derives from (roleId, name).

lowerIsBetter.description: Colours reductions as buffs in tooltips.

displayType.description: How the stat renders in tooltips. percentage is the default, also used for any unrecognised value.
